stories.title: US corporate AI debt surge tests investor limits as fatigue emerges
stories.simple_summary: Big companies are spending huge amounts of money on AI and investors are starting to worry that they're spending too much without making the money back.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and large companies — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV: In age of AI, the family is the first school of humanity
stories.simple_summary: The Pope spoke about how AI is becoming important in the world, and said families should focus on being places where people learn human values.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a religious or philosophical statement — it doesn't directly affect how you use technology in your daily life.

stories.title: Billionaire Investor Stanley Druckenmiller Just Sold Intel and Micron, and Piled Into 2 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks That Are Betting Big on Robotics
stories.simple_summary: A very wealthy investor sold his shares in two computer chip companies and instead bought shares in two AI companies focused on robots.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Brazil launches AI supercomputer push while balancing US and Chinese tech
stories.simple_summary: Brazil is building a very powerful computer to work with AI, while trying to stay balanced between technology from the United States and China.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a government-level decision that mostly matters to investors and tech workers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom
stories.simple_summary: A startup company that collects information for training AI systems is growing very quickly because so many AI companies need that data.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech industry workers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Micron CEO: AI has 'totally changed' the equation for the boom-and-bust memory industry
stories.simple_summary: The leader of a computer chip company says AI has changed how their business works because the demand is so different and unpredictable now.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
stories.simple_summary: Businesses are switching between different AI tools (like trying different stores) depending on which one has the best new features, which makes investors unsure if customers will stick with them long-term.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plug-in
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT (an AI that talks like a person) can now help you write text messages on iPhones by writing them for you.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have an iPhone and struggle with typing text messages, this could be a handy helper — but you don't have to use it.

stories.title: Google Discover is getting an AI chatbot-tuned feed
stories.simple_summary: Google is adding AI to its Discover feed (the suggestions Google shows you) so you can describe what you want to see and it will remember your preferences next time.
stories.why_it_matters: This could make Google's suggestions match what you want better — but the changes are happening automatically if you use Google on your phone.

stories.title: TVA proposes new data center power rate starting in October, with 10% average increase
stories.simple_summary: The local power company is raising the price of electricity by about 10% for data centers (huge buildings full of computers) starting in October.
stories.why_it_matters: This could lead to slightly higher internet costs eventually — it mostly affects large tech companies, not your bill directly.

stories.title: OK, can we actually cool data centers with our pee?
stories.simple_summary: A tech website is joking about (but also half-seriously exploring) whether human urine could be used to cool the big computers that run AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a fun, silly story — it's not a real solution being considered for your everyday life.

stories.title: Google gives publishers a new way to fight AI-driven traffic losses
stories.simple_summary: Google is giving news publishers a new button they can add so that readers can tell Google to recommend their articles more often, helping them fight against traffic losses from AI search tools.
stories.why_it_matters: If you publish news or content online, this gives you a new tool to fight back against AI — otherwise, nothing you need to act on.
